newsitem.title: UK: Enterprise plans big acquisition - paper.
newsitem.headline: Enterprise plans big acquisition - paper.

text.p: Enterprise Oil Plc is considering a major acquisition for at least 1.0 billion stg ($1.61 billion), a British newspaper reported on Sunday.
In an interview with The Observer, Enterprise Oil's chief executive Pierre Jungels said he planned to expand the company by a mixture of internal growth and acquisition.
"I would not rule out a corporate acquisition within the next 12 months," Jungels said.
The Observer said Enterprise was prepared to spend at least 1.0 billion stg on an acquisition, and Monument Oil and Gas Plc was a possible take-over candidate.
Enterprise Oil is due to release its 1996 results on Thursday, and higher oil prices and increased production are likely to have raised profits substantially.
Analysts have forecast annual profit after tax between 142.6 million stg and 157.0 million stg, compared with 101.6 million in 1995.

Enterprise shares outshone all other FTSE 100 companies in 1996 as good news on new oil finds flowed in. This restored its reputation with investors, which was hurt by Enterprise's failed bid three years ago for rival LASMO Plc.
